title: Ike's Morning Digest
data_note: Built from publisher RSS metadata (titles + teaser text). `coverage_window_hours` is the default (40h); several feeds use a longer `rollingHours` (see `scripts/build-digest.mjs`) so rows align with what is still on each publisher’s listing pages. Commercial Observer keeps its retail category + hub supplement; TRD adds a New York–filtered global retail tag feed. PincusCo uses the live site feed only (`/category/retail/feed/` is stale). **CRE Daily** retail briefs come from `credaily.com/sectors/retail/feed/`. **WSJ** is the Dow Jones real-estate feed with lifestyle and opinion dropped. **The New York Times** keeps real-estate and property stories only. **Traded** is commercial deal briefs from its news listing. Open each link for the full article (subscriptions may apply in the browser).

section_overviews.commercial_observer:
PNC Bank Inks 4K-SF Retail Lease at 312 West 43rd Street: Residents at the Ellery , a mixed-use residential development in Manhattan’s Hell’s Kitchen neighborhood, are getting another retailer at the base of their 33-story home. PNC Bank has signed a 3,500-square-foot retail lease at the base of the property at 312 West 43rd Street , according to co-developers and co-owners.

TJ Maxx Signs 29K-SF Deal to Replace H&M at 150 East 86th Street: Discount department store T.J. Maxx is replacing H&M in a busy retail spread on Manhattan’s Upper East Side, Commercial Observer has learned.

Camera Brand Fujifilm Takes 13K SF at 210 Lafayette Street in SoHo: A Japanese camera manufacturer is setting up shop in Manhattan’s photogenic SoHo neighborhood. Fujifilm signed a lease for 12,700 square feet at Comjem Associates ’ 210 Lafayette Street for what could be a brick-and-mortar retail location similar to stores operated by B&H or Adorama .

Bath & Body Works to Open 9K-SF Store in Flatiron District: Bath & Body Works is opening a new store in Manhattan’s Flatiron District. The soap and scented lotion purveyor has signed a lease to take over the entire nearly 9,000-square-foot retail portion of 129 Fifth Avenue , according to a source with knowledge of the deal.
section_overviews.cre_daily:
Hines Says Retail Recovery Is an Income and Scarcity Call: Hines Research says retail pricing has recovered across open-air centers and enclosed malls in the U.S. and Europe, while lagging Asian markets could offer opportunity.

Mark IV Breaks Ground on 41,500 SF Round Rock Retail Plaza: Mark IV Capital broke ground in October on a 41,521 SF plaza at The District in Round Rock, with six single-story buildings and room for nine to 14 restaurant and lifestyle tenants.

Retail Vacancy Falls to 4.3% as Q3 Absorption Hits 10.5M SF: National retail vacancy fell 10 basis points to 4.3% in Q3, while shopping center vacancy slipped to 5.4% and mall vacancy dropped 30 basis points to 8.2%. Leasing totaled 38.4M SF and net absorption hit 10.5M SF, led by general retail at 5.4M SF, with shopping centers at 3.0M SF and malls at 1.9M SF.

Record Diesel Prices Squeeze Retail Development Pipeline: Diesel averaged $6.38 per gallon on Sept. 28, up from about $3.81 in late February, adding to construction and supply-chain costs for retail developers and retailers.

items.headline: Hines Says Retail Recovery Is an Income and Scarcity Call
items.summary: Hines Research says retail pricing has recovered across open-air centers and enclosed malls in the U.S. and Europe, while lagging Asian markets could offer opportunity. About 480M SF of U.S. retail has been demolished since 2000 and development has been slow for over a decade, which Hines calls an underappreciated supply story. Hines frames the opportunity as an income and scarcity call, with returns driven by leasing and execution, and grocery anchors worth about 25% above-market rents in Atlanta.…

items.headline: Mark IV Breaks Ground on 41,500 SF Round Rock Retail Plaza
items.summary: Mark IV Capital broke ground in October on a 41,521 SF plaza at The District in Round Rock, with six single-story buildings and room for nine to 14 restaurant and lifestyle tenants. The plaza is the project’s second vertical phase and is due in 2028, alongside the 316-unit Origin apartments that began construction in March with $86M in funding.…

items.headline: Retail Vacancy Falls to 4.3% as Q3 Absorption Hits 10.5M SF
items.summary: National retail vacancy fell 10 basis points to 4.3% in Q3, while shopping center vacancy slipped to 5.4% and mall vacancy dropped 30 basis points to 8.2%. Leasing totaled 38.4M SF and net absorption hit 10.5M SF, led by general retail at 5.4M SF, with shopping centers at 3.0M SF and malls at 1.9M SF. Elevated construction and financing costs keep supply tight, with 58.1M SF under construction, and Colliers expects limited development to support measured rent growth through 2026.…

items.summary: Discount department store T.J. Maxx is replacing H&M in a busy retail spread on Manhattan’s Upper East Side, Commercial Observer has learned. T.J. Maxx has signed a lease for 28,837 square feet at Extell Development ’s retail condominium unit at 150 East 86th Street , according to a source close to the deal and a third-quarter Manhattan retail report from CBRE .…

items.headline: Record Diesel Prices Squeeze Retail Development Pipeline
items.summary: Diesel averaged $6.38 per gallon on Sept. 28, up from about $3.81 in late February, adding to construction and supply-chain costs for retail developers and retailers. Just over 60M SF of retail is under construction, 4% above the all-time low CoStar has recorded, while JLL put Q2 vacancy at 4.4% and net absorption at 10.2M SF. Retailers such as Aldi, Burlington, TJ Maxx and Dollar Tree plan large store expansions, but flat rents and rising costs mean limited new supply to absorb them.…

items.headline: Bath & Body Works to Open 9K-SF Store in Flatiron District

Bath & Body Works will move into the two-level retail unit, owned by Acadia Realty Trust , in the fall of 2027, according to Crain’s New York Business , which first reported the lease.…

items.headline: Manhattan Retail Availability Hits Record Low as Banks Expand
items.summary: Average availability across Manhattan’s prime retail corridors dropped to 11.4% in Q3 2026, the lowest reading since JLL began tracking in 2017, with only 157 spaces left. Bank of America, OceanFirst and Citibank signed leases totaling nearly 35,000 square feet, and JLL says many more bank deals are pending, adding fresh competition for storefronts.…

items.headline: Southern California Retail Markets Tighten as Tenant Demand Picks Up
items.summary: Southern California’s retail real estate market continued to tighten in the third quarter of 2026, with positive net absorption and declining vacancy across much of the region, according to a new report released Monday from Colliers . Retail tenants absorbed about 757,600 square feet during the quarter across Los Angeles and Orange counties and the Inland Empire. Overall vacancy fell 12 basis points from the second quarter to 6.15 percent, while leasing activity totaled 2.5 million square feet.…

items.headline: Miami Retail Pipeline Hits 1.3M SF, Highest Since Early 2023
items.summary: Miami-Dade’s retail pipeline reached 1.3M SF in the third quarter, double last year’s level, as developers gain confidence in a market with 3% direct vacancy. Leasing slowed to 257K SF across 118 deals from 413K SF across 150 deals in Q2, and absorption turned negative, yet triple-net asking rents set a record $44.34 per SF. Heavy preleasing is letting developers underwrite new projects, but vacancy below 3% in core submarkets means tenants must stay flexible to find space.…

items.summary: Charter school network BridgePrep Academy will open another location, this time inside a shopping center in Miami-Dade County. The 273,050-square-foot property, owned by RK Centers , sits west of Interstate 95 at 750 Ives Dairy Road .…

items.summary: Udon Shin , a popular Japanese restaurant with only two other U.S. locations, is gearing up to open its first New York City eatery, Commercial Observer has learned. Asking rent was $30,000 per month for the space previously occupied by now-closed Italian restaurant Basta Pasta.…

items.headline: Sports Retailer Lids to Open New Shop Inside Penn Station
items.summary: Sports apparel retailer Lids is adding another location in New York City, this time inside Midtown’s bustling Pennsylvania Station , Commercial Observer has learned. Lids, which sells sports hats, jerseys and fan apparel, has inked a 10-year, 1,993-square-foot lease for a flagship location inside the Vornado Realty Trust -managed transit hub. Lids is the largest licensed sports-minded retailer in North America, with more than 1,300 stores, according to tenant broker JLL .…

items.summary: Lower Manhattan’s South Street Seaport will be living la dolce vita with its latest restaurant lease. items.headline: New York Office Tenant Improvement Totals Rise in 2026 Amid Market Shifts
items.summary: Manhattan tenant improvement (TI) allowances — costs that commercial landlords cover for tenants to remodel spaces — have dramatically evolved since the pandemic. Gone are the days in which these allowances functioned as a simple deal sweetener to entice the city’s white-shoe law firms and digital media startups. Instead, brokers and landlords say it is a structural — albeit costly — necessity in today’s deal-making.…

items.summary: Data software company Databricks has doubled its office footprint at 5 Bryant Park less than a year after its arrival. The company inked the major lease expansion to accommodate the expanding headcount of its New York City-based research, development and engineering hub, according to a Databricks blog post on Monday. Its doubled office space now spans a total of 120,000 square feet across five floors of the Savanna -owned tower.…

items.headline: Eagle AI Takes 7K-SF Office at 120 Fifth Avenue in Flatiron District
items.summary: The eagle has landed at Bromley Companies ’ Flatiron District office property. Eagle AI , an artificial intelligence-based solutions provider, has taken 6,500 square feet of office space at 120 Fifth Avenue , according to the landlord. The deal, signed in September, is for an entire floor. Bromley did not provide the length of the lease or the asking rent. The average asking rent for office space in Midtown Manhattan was $85.08 per square foot during the third quarter of 2026, according to Colliers data.…
